name: Guaynabo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green hoist charged with a white and black cross fleury, and a white fly with an indented edge in the form of battlements.
history: Guaynabo is a city and municipality on the northeastern coastal plain of Puerto Rico. The cross is the symbol of Saint Peter Martyr of Verona, patron saint of Guaynabo.

features.role: cross fleury of Saint Peter Martyr in white and black
